name: Pinarello
verdict: Sold by investment firm L Catterton to a private family office in June 2023 (company announcement).
note: Italian bike brand; Netcompany INEOS's bike partner, its mark on the chest, upper back and shorts of the 2026 kit. Cycling trade press (Cyclingnews) reported the June 2023 buyer is linked to mining billionaire Ivan Glasenberg; no human-rights finding against the company found.
